coder_notes: Nivolumab and bevacizumab are not registered interventions but are named in arm labels and the intervention description. Nivolumab treated as the only investigational pharmacological agent (EO2401 vaccine excluded type). Bevacizumab (US only, Cohort 3) coded established_therapy_experiment as an added established GBM therapy in one cohort; if instead counted as investigational, nivolumab would be experimental_combination (candidate status unchanged). HLA-A2 positivity is germline/immunological and not recorded; unmethylated MGMT mentioned only as a permission to enter without prior temozolomide, not an entry requirement. Target engagement unclear: immunogenicity endpoint is for the vaccine, not linked to nivolumab.
